title: 24 ## PERSONS ARRESTED During 1969, 10,34,268 persons were arrested as against 10,42,307 during 1968. This does not include 5,33,874 persons arrested in Assam in satyagraha movements. The variations over 1968 in the different States and Union Territories were erratic. Table 9 presents the number of arrests for I.P.C. crimes during 1968 and 1969 and percentage variations in States, Union Territories and important Cities.
